name: loft
description: Teaches a coding agent to write, change and review a Loft specification in spec/ with the loft command line, and shows the Loft status pane while it works.

baseBranch.title: Base branch
baseBranch.description: The revision the Loft status pane compares the tree with, as `loft status --base` takes it.

loftCommand.title: loft command
loftCommand.description: The command that runs loft, such as `loft`, `npx --no-install loft` or `pnpm exec loft`.
